change_summary: Keep selected attachment evidence in the same authorized effect as any durable owner or topology mutation, rather than applying pasted facts while leaving the source local.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill generalizes compound evidence handling from topology corrections to every authorized durable owner mutation while preserving the one-off no-write boundary.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-15.7 makes selected evidence retention part of the same effect as content or topology mutation while preserving Agent-owned Work Model planning and typed Runtime receipts.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.47 without changing transport, trust, consent, or compatibility-family boundaries.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.32; registry-backed update checks return an exact install command plus post-install verification, and Workspace capabilities expose server-owned limits.

help_center.note: Public guidance explains that a selected attachment used to update existing durable owners must remain traceable, while attachment presence alone stays no-write.

package_setup.note: Setup and SessionStart keep selected evidence with authorized owner or topology mutations without turning arbitrary attachments into write consent.

harness_and_mainline.note: The owner history records the live localized-update provenance miss and keeps fresh effect proof explicit rather than adding Runtime semantic enforcement.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.47 publication and hashes can be verified here; Claude directory acceptance and fresh secondary-host behavior remain external receipts.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover durable content and topology update composition, adapter convergence, ordinary one-off and attachment-only countercases, package export, and localized Help; J5T3 fresh rerun is the live behavior gate.
